title: Keycard / encoder failure (room access)
description: Front desk cannot encode a keycard or the encoded card does not open the guest room door.
problemDescription: Mã thẻ từ không mở được cửa. Keycard encoder fails, card not recognized, door does not unlock.
prerequisites: Employee is at the front desk
Employee has the guest's room number / reservation
expectedResult: A working keycard that opens the correct guest room.
failureCondition: After all steps the encoder still fails or the card still will not open the door.
escalationCondition: Hardware fault suspected (encoder or door lock) or steps exhausted without resolution.

steps.instruction: Is the encoder connected and showing ready? (USB/network LED solid, no red error.)

branches.conditionText: encoder disconnected / not ready / red error

steps.instruction: Check the encoder cable / reconnect it, and confirm the encoder software is open and logged in. Restart the encoder app if needed.
Re-encode the card for the correct room. Does the encoder report success?
Test the card at the door. Does it unlock?
Confirm the room number matches the reservation in the PMS, then retry encode with a fresh blank card. Does it succeed now?
Try a different encoder (backup station) or a different door lock reader if available. Does a card from the backup work?
Great — issue the working card to the guest and confirm.
